name: Iarsma
history: Iarsma fue un grupo activo en 2014, de estilo post-rock con influencias de God Is an Astronaut, Shogün, My Sleeping Karma, Jardín de la Croix, Brutus, The Fourth Cloud, Holy Fawn, Russian Circles y Toundra.
historyEn: Iarsma was a band active in 2014, of post-rock style with influences of God Is an Astronaut, Shogün, My Sleeping Karma, Jardín de la Croix, Brutus, The Fourth Cloud, Holy Fawn, Russian Circles and Toundra.
